results.title: Cold Feet
results.overview: Outside, a great storm. Inside, by the warmth of the hearth, a couple doesn't know that tonight will be unlike any of the last forty years…

results.title: Super Happy Fun Clown
results.overview: To escape a life of oppressed obscurity, a battered former wunderkind weaponizes her obsession with clowning, serial killers, and classic movie monsters into a night of shocking infamy.

results.title: A Night at Paladium
results.overview: Paladium. One of the busiest and most fashionable nightclubs in Buenos Aires, where artists, LGBT activists, traditional tangueros, and the newest generation of Argentine rock musicians would all cohabit with freedom and morality. And now?

results.title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part II
results.original_title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part II
results.overview: Four friends' lives become intertwined when romance blooms between a doctor and a comedian, while his best friend falls for her free-spirited bestie. After a tragic event, their relationships evolve into something deeper than friendship.

results.title: Vanja Orico, Ao Arrepio Do Tempo
results.original_title: Vanja Orico, Ao Arrepio Do Tempo

results.title: Deke's Art
results.overview: A failed artist creates an immersive bar based on his estranged friend's dysfunctional childhood, but when the friend shows up, his reaction is unexpected.

results.title: Not Me That Went Viral
results.overview: Yamagata is a middle-aged real estate sales manager. One day, a Twitter account that appears to belong to him seems to incriminate him for a murder of a young woman. He knows nothing about the account – but an online outrage declares him a dangerous criminal, and he ends up running for his life, both from the police and clout-chasing YouTubers. A body of another murdered young woman turns up at his house, and he receives an accusatory letter from the one who has framed him. But who would do such a thing? He's well-liked by everyone… or so he thinks.

results.title: The Baby in the Basket
results.overview: In 1940s, the nuns of a remote Scottish island convent ready for an impending storm, but when a baby is left on their doorstep, Sister Agnes becomes convinced he is the Devil and wants to kill the child. After Agnes is locked away a grim series of events ensue as the storm rages, and as her Sisters begin to question faith and reality, Sister Eleanor must try to repent and survive the dark events at St Augustine’s.

results.title: Neel Chokro
results.overview: A determined investigator uncovers the dark mystery of blackmail, suicide, and crimes carried out through social media. He discovers a larger conspiracy involving justice and revenge.

results.title: THE DRIP
results.overview: Pedro, a man trapped in the rutine and silence of his room, where an water drop turns into the echo of an emotional pain. What starts as an odd sound, leads him to discover a box full of memories that detonates a silence catharsis.

results.title: Foreigner
results.overview: Set in 2004, Iranian immigrant Yasamin aka Yasi is the new girl at a Canadian school. Her high school experience is daunting, as she tries to improve her English by watching her favorite sitcom and befriends a trio of pastel-clad girls who feed Yasi’s need to fit in. Desperate for acceptance, she dyes her hair blonde and, in doing so, also attracts a demonic force.

results.title: Our Lady
results.overview: Katie, a theatre teacher at an all girls Catholic school in Melbourne, and the director of the school's musical production, has to deal with late cast and crew, demanding staff members, and a chaos-inducing gift, all within 30 minutes of their opening night.

results.title: Fed Up
results.overview: Twila, a morally conscious cannibal, struggles to resist a dangerously primal obsession with her insecure boyfriend, Gerlach.

results.title: Confessions in Static
results.overview: When a real-life house of horror is reopened as a tourist attraction, four friends decide to teach the inhabitants a lesson. But nothing is what it seems, and nobody is telling the truth in this darkly comic twist on the found footage movie.

results.title: Korpus
results.overview: During an excavation at the old limestone factory, something is unearthed. The lime settles in the heat. An awakening is underway. At the swimming lake, a young teenage girl experiences desire for the first time. On her usual route home, she takes a shortcut through the old limestone factory and makes a discovery.
